mentions.videoTitle: When paying £9 for two tacos here, you’ll think they’ve made a mistake. 📍 Homies On Donkeys
mentions.notes: Topjaw extensively reviews their tacos (mole duck, steak, beef birria, salmon al pastor, blue potato taquitos). Describes them as scientific-level skill with exceptional value at £9 per taco, and addresses their financial struggles to encourage support.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional value Mexican; scientific-level skill, overwhelmingly tasty.

mentions.videoTitle: Quo Vadis is officially 100 years old! "There's always been someone mad enough to run it"
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited this 100-year-old London institution and gave extensive personal opinions on multiple dishes including smoked eel sandwich, potted shrimp sandwich, burger, fish and chips, chicken velouté pie, and multiple puddings.
mentions.verdict: Iconic London institution with outstanding British-Italian cooking.

mentions.videoTitle: Incredible value at the very exciting Agora.
mentions.notes: Topjaw praises the incredible value and unbeatable flavours, textures and atmosphere. Highlights the strong dip game, perfectly cooked pork belly with crispy skin, slow-cooked chicken thigh, pork souvlaki, spiced nduja flatbread with roasted pineapple, and confit lamb flatbread with spiced tomato.
mentions.verdict: Most outrageous value in London, pure deliciousness.
dishes: Confit lamb flatbread w/spiced tomato and garlic yoghurt

mentions.videoTitle: AGORA has to be the best value restaurant in London right now.
mentions.notes: Topjaw raves about it as the best value restaurant in London with outstanding dips, pork belly, slow-cooked chicken thigh, and lamb flatbread at incredibly low prices (5-6 quid per dish). Emphasizes the electric atmosphere and quality execution.
mentions.verdict: Best value in London, pure open fire deliciousness.
dishes: Confit lamb flatbread w/spiced tomato and garlic yoghurt

mentions.videoTitle: 2210 is London’s most exciting Caribbean restaurant right now.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visits and thoroughly reviews the Caribbean restaurant owned by Nathaniel. He praises multiple dishes including the jerk chicken, confit pork belly, and wiri wiri lamb rump, highlighting the smoky depth, texture, and presentation.
mentions.verdict: London's most exciting Caribbean restaurant right now.

mentions.videoTitle: Authentic tacos and a remarkable story: Guacamoles, Peckham.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed Manny and Gabriella's authentic Mexican restaurant. He praised the tacos, highlighting the El Pastor taco and pork carnitas as exceptional value, and featured their remarkable story of escaping cartel threats in Mexico and building a business in London.
mentions.verdict: Outstanding tacos at remarkable value. Deserves huge success.

mentions.videoTitle: Is this the best steak restaurant in London? Basque style indulgence at Ibai.
mentions.notes: Topjaw praises the Galician Blond rib for its rendered fat, the King Crab Rice made with a six-hour carabinero prawn bisque reduction (which he says he still thinks about over a year later), Wagyu steak, French fries cooked in beef fat recreating '90s McDonald's style, and Flake steak with 36 layers.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional meat-focused restaurant with standout dishes.

mentions.videoTitle: Is IBAI The Best Steak Restaurant in London?
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and gave extensive personal review of this meat-focused restaurant opened by Txuleta. He praised the quality of steaks, pinches, tortilla, king crab rice, and dessert across multiple dishes.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional steaks and meat dishes, best in London for meat fans.

mentions.videoTitle: Exclusive first look at the new Crisp Pizza; The Marlborough 👀
mentions.notes: Topjaw reviewed the new Crisp Pizza opening at The Marlborough in Mayfair. He praised the pizza quality, noting it's better than the original Hammersmith location, and highlighted the new 21st century booking system.
mentions.verdict: Better than Hammersmith location, excellent pizza quality.
dishes: New Haven style cheese bar pie

mentions.videoTitle: New restaurant incoming, Hausu.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited Hausu and gave detailed reviews of multiple dishes. The restaurant is a low-fi Japanese bar that opened in a converted cold room space. Ella Williams was so impressed she applied to work there.
mentions.verdict: Excellent Japanese bar with standout lemon butter noodles and prawn scallop toast.

mentions.videoTitle: Knave Of Clubs has mastered the rotisserie chicken.
mentions.notes: Topjaw praised the rotisserie chicken as "the best I've ever had in my entire life". The chicken is brined for 4 hours and can be served with chermoula spices. It's rubbed with a rich chicken sauce made from roasted chicken wings, described as tender like "a savory Victoria sponge".
mentions.verdict: Best rotisserie chicken, tender and expertly executed.

mentions.videoTitle: Camille is the first restaurant by Chef Elliot Hashtroudi, formerly at Trullo and St John.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and extensively reviewed multiple dishes including duck neck sausage, puff pig skin, sweet bread, and stuffed quail. Called it 'one of the most exciting restaurants in London right now' and praised the rare originality, deliciousness, and quality of execution.
mentions.verdict: One of the most exciting restaurants in London right now.

mentions.videoTitle: Chef Nieves has been planning this place for 8 years. Legado is ambitious but it delivers in spades.
mentions.notes: Chef Nieves' new restaurant after 8 years of planning. Casual all-day restaurant with a bar and pintxos, blending Spanish cuisine from across all regions. Topjaw tried 10 dishes, each with Michelin-Star Sabor quality.
mentions.verdict: Ambitious execution with signature quality throughout.
dishes: Sweet peppers with tempura crust and truffle honey
Stuffed squid with euro, prawns and squid ink sauce

mentions.videoTitle: Fish, Wings & Tings - great value, a relaxed feel and truly moreish food. 🇹🇹❤️
mentions.notes: Brian has been cooking his family recipes here for 14 years. The place offers great value, relaxed Caribbean atmosphere with authentic dishes including jerk chicken, fish roti, and wings with house-made sauce.
mentions.verdict: Punches above its weight; authentic Caribbean vibe.
dishes: jerk chicken with rice and peas

mentions.videoTitle: Best Curry in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and extensively reviewed. Praised the butter chicken wings as signature dish, bone marrow biryani, mixed grill, and fish paal bun. Part of voting compilation but Topjaw gives own detailed opinions throughout.
mentions.verdict: Signature butter chicken wings phenomenal; diverse menu reflects UK food excellence.

mentions.videoTitle: In at Number 5 for the Top 5 Curries in London - Brigadiers!
mentions.notes: Topjaw reviews Brigadiers as their number five pick for best curries in London. Despite not serving traditional curry, he praises their Indian barbecue food, beautifully spiced grilled meats, and unusual takes on classic Indian snacks including butter chicken wings, cheese and onion baas, fish pow, bone marrow biryani, and mixed grill.
mentions.verdict: Number five for best curries in London; beautifully spiced.
dishes: goat shoulder with Roen Josh sauce

mentions.videoTitle: Still need to book somewhere great? We’ve got you! ❤️🎄❤️
mentions.notes: Indian barbecue with smoky cocktails, beer towers, and barbecue butter chicken wings. Topjaw says it's so good it makes him tear up.
mentions.verdict: Excellent Indian barbecue, ultimate group feast.

mentions.videoTitle: Best Curry in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed with team. Praised the lamb chops masala as tender and smoky, dal sagaloo, naan quality, and mutton papadom. Noted it's a 53-year-old institution.
mentions.verdict: Tender lamb chops, delicious naan, exceptional dal sagaloo; institution deserves respect.

mentions.videoTitle: The Punjabi institution Tayyabs has been around for 50+ years,  still run by the original family.
mentions.notes: Topjaw praised this Punjabi Pakistani institution for its smoky, delicious food with great theatre. They highlighted the quality of the meat dishes, particularly the marinated lamb chops and mutton, and described it as good honest food.
mentions.verdict: Excellent Punjabi cuisine with standout meat dishes and theatre.

mentions.videoTitle: Best Curry in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed at 9am. Praised the creative menu with filthy crisps, crustacean snacks, prawn pani sandwich, Norfolk beef, and dessert. Fourth visit and notes continuous improvement.
mentions.verdict: Creative playful Indian menu; continuously improving; every visit raises the bar.
dishes: Black chickpea crustacean with ginger raspberry yogurt
Dessert with Alfonso mango and white chocolate

mentions.videoTitle: There is nothing else like BiBi in London.
mentions.notes: Topjaw's fourth visit to this Indian restaurant. Praised the innovative non-curry dishes, black chickpea crustace with ginger-raspberry yogurt, dorla with chalk shroom trout, Sharma's mori chicken (granddad's recipe), pani presentation with blood orange and green chili, and red mullet grilled hard on the skin and rested in peanut pile. Exceptional counter seating experience.
mentions.verdict: Unique Indian cooking that keeps improving with each visit.
dishes: black chickpea crustace with ginger-raspberry yogurt
pani with blood orange and green chili
red mullet grilled on skin with peanut pile

mentions.videoTitle: Are These The Best Date Spots in London? ft. 5 Dates In 1 Day
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed the Indian fine dining restaurant opened by chef Chet Sharma. Praised the elegant interior inspired by his grandmother's pashminas and highlighted dishes combining British products with Indian flavors.
mentions.verdict: Outstanding Indian fine dining with exceptional cuisine and beautiful interior.
dishes: Carlingford oysters with oyster and yogurt cream

mentions.videoTitle: Best Curry in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed with chef/owner Asma. Praised butter chicken masala toasty, brinjal curry, prawn malai curry, keema spinach, and Kubani Gamita dessert. Notes maternal family recipes.
mentions.verdict: Maternal family recipes soul food; exciting brinjal curry, prawn curry levels, healing spinach dish.

mentions.videoTitle: Darjeeling Express's Asma Khan is one of our favourite people to see.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visits with Asma Khan and eats multiple dishes. They praise the family recipes, highlighting the unique Badami Baingan, Chicken Butter Masala Toastie, and Prawn Malai Curry. They commend the all-female kitchen team and discuss how family recipes are authentically served.
mentions.verdict: Incredible family recipes, standout curries, all-female team.

mentions.videoTitle: We’re so thankful that Darjeeling Express and Asma Khan exist.
mentions.notes: Topjaw gives detailed first-hand review of dishes including kosa mango (Bengali mutton curry), tangr prawns with garlic and chili, and kima toasty with smoky flavor. Restaurant supports women and children in India.
mentions.verdict: Chef's favorite with incredible rich sauces and deep flavors.

mentions.videoTitle: Best Curry in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed. Praised famous lamb chops (marinated 7+ hours), butter chicken, pork cheek curry, and the tasting menu experience. Noted two Michelin stars for Indian cuisine.
mentions.verdict: Famous lamb chops perfectly marinated; butter chicken outstanding; one of London's hottest.

mentions.videoTitle: As voted for by chefs, the Number 1 curry in London: Gymkhana
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and gave extensive personal review. Praised signature lamb chops marinated overnight, butter chicken, pork vindaloo, and aloo chaat. Highlighted that it's one of only 4 restaurants with Indian cuisine holding 2 Michelin stars. Topjaw wholeheartedly agrees it deserves the #1 curry ranking.
mentions.verdict: Best curry in London, wholeheartedly agree.

mentions.videoTitle: We find the 3 Best Indian Restaurants in London
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and thoroughly reviewed this high-end Indian restaurant. Janak Vyas, their guest, called it 'the best Indian restaurant in London.' Topjaw praised the masala lamb chops, detailed the ambiance modeled on old Delhi sports clubs, and extensively reviewed multiple dishes including goat pal bhajis, aloo chaat, queenie scallops, quail kebabs, tiger prawns, and biryani.
mentions.verdict: Phenomenal high-end Indian dining, best lamb chops in the city.
dishes: Goat pal bhajis with crispy onions

mentions.videoTitle: Open fire cooking at Goldies by French brothers Max & Yannis. A thoroughly underrated Soho spot.
mentions.notes: Topjaw has eaten pretty much the whole menu at Goldies. They highlight the mixed grill, fries with dips, marinated baby chicken, pork chop, and burger as standouts. Chef Will Samuel is continuously improving the menu.
mentions.verdict: Underrated open fire cooking spot with evolving menu.
dishes: BBQ Corn with Café de Paris butter
Marinated Whole Chicken with smoked yogurt

mentions.videoTitle: New Opening: Goldies, Soho. Supremely tasty open fire cooking by wonder-brothers Maxime & Yannis.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited this new opening and gave extensive praise. Open fire barbecue cooking by brothers Maxime & Yannis with incredible value burgers. 45-day dry age beef burger with sesame crust, caramelized onions and pepper sauce is exceptional.
mentions.verdict: Supremely tasty open fire cooking, exceptional value.
dishes: Wow Burger with 45-day dry age beef
BBQ Corn with Café de Peri butter
Profiterole with chocolate, hazelnut, caramel sauce

mentions.videoTitle: Best Breakfast/Brunch in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited the Chelsea location and reviewed multiple dishes including fresh Aussie (poached eggs, trout, avocado), corn fritters with bacon, and pancakes. Praised as a classic with consistently good food.
mentions.verdict: Classic brunch spot, healthy options, never had a bad meal.

mentions.videoTitle: Best Breakfast/Brunch in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed multiple Japanese breakfast dishes including pickled daikon, mackerel with miso soup, trout on rice, and udon noodles with eggs and bacon in broth. Praised authenticity and hand-made udon.
mentions.verdict: Beautiful authentic Japanese breakfast, loved by chefs and industry folk.
dishes: Mackerel with miso soup and rice
Udon noodles with eggs, bacon and mushrooms in broth

mentions.videoTitle: Best Breakfast/Brunch in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed E Pellicci's full English breakfast called 'Have the Lot', including fried bread, beans, bubble and squeak, hash browns, triple bacon, and jam tart made by the owner's mother. Praised the chaotic warmth and authentic family atmosphere.
mentions.verdict: Old school cash-only greasy spoon with chaotic warmth and energy.

mentions.videoTitle: In at No.3 it’s E Pellicci the wonderfully mad place.
mentions.notes: Topjaw personally visited and praised the chaotic warmth, atmosphere, and the 'Have the lot' breakfast featuring fried bread, bacon, hash browns, puddings, sausage, beans, mushrooms and tomatoes. Run by Anna, Nev and family for 125 years.
mentions.verdict: Wonderfully mad place with excellent breakfast and vibe.
dishes: chabata toasted mozzarella with homemade beef ragu

mentions.videoTitle: Best Breakfast/Brunch in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed multiple dishes including molted waffle with bacon and poached egg, sausage patty McMuffin-style on croissant, mushrooms on toast with brie and truffle, and a special pancake hybrid. Praised the quality and execution.
mentions.verdict: Phenomenal brunch, cheffy but delicious yummy food, really popular dishes.
dishes: Molted waffle with bacon, black pudding and poached egg
Sausage patty, bacon, cheese and egg on croissant
Mushrooms on toast with brie and truffle hollandaise

mentions.videoTitle: Best Breakfast/Brunch in London: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited the Michelin-starred Hide and reviewed breakfast dishes including truffle scrambled eggs on brioche, crock monster with black truffle, sliced mango, custard with rhubarb and laminated pastry, French toast with almond crème brûlée, and banana pecan croissant. Praised the elevation of classic dishes.
mentions.verdict: Elevated classics in a different dimension, perfect for special occasion breakfast.
dishes: Crock monster with black truffle gravy
French toast with crispy almond crème brûlée

mentions.videoTitle: 5 Of The Best Brunches In London - ft. Truffle Scrambled Eggs, Pancakes & A Full English
mentions.notes: Michelin-starred restaurant that received its star within 5 months of opening. Features exceptional brunch with truffle scrambled eggs and innovative dishes. Remarkable design and service.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional Michelin-starred brunch; everything is elite-level.
dishes: French toast with bechamel and cherries

mentions.videoTitle: Whole Beast should be on your radar!
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited Whole Beast and reviewed their award-winning burger made with Norfolk Wagyu and Yorkshire beef, tender smoked mutton tacos, and spicy pig's head pot pie. Run by husband and wife team Sam and Alice.
mentions.verdict: Award-winning burger, tender mutton tacos, delicious pig's head pot pie.

mentions.videoTitle: Whole Beast should be on your radar!
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited Exale Tap/Taproom and drank their beers, noting their corn-focused beer and that the food at Whole Beast pairs well with their beer selection.
mentions.verdict: Quality beers that pair well with meat-focused food.

mentions.videoTitle: PTSD from the infamous ‘Gobbler’… RIP 🦃
mentions.notes: Thomas Stock, co-founder of Burger and Beyond, discusses their burger offerings. Topjaw references the 'Gobbler' as a signature burger special.
mentions.verdict: Great burger option, though the Gobbler special was disappointing.

mentions.videoTitle: Morchella keeps getting better and better!
mentions.notes: Topjaw praises the restaurant highly, highlighting that the owners have leveled up with beautiful modern Mediterranean cuisine. He emphasizes the exceptional food quality and mentions he wants to return repeatedly.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional modern Mediterranean, groundshakingly good food.
dishes: Beef Short Rib with aged mushroom peppercorn sauce

mentions.videoTitle: Where every cocktail has a story behind it, Lyaness.
mentions.notes: Ryan Chetiyawardana leads the team. Only bar in the world with three pins in the Pinnacle guide. Each cocktail has a story behind it - Kentucky Fried Cocktail, Unfiltered Martini, and Faux Fruit Sour exemplify their creative approach linking to moments of culture.
mentions.verdict: Innovative cocktails with compelling stories and cultural links.

mentions.videoTitle: Where every cocktail has a story behind it, @lyanessbar.
mentions.notes: Ryan Chetiyawardana and team constantly reinventing cocktails daily. Each cocktail has a story behind it. Three pins in Pinnacle guide. Featured cocktails: Kentucky Fried (with KFC herbs and spices through Japanese lens), Unfiltered Martini (wheat buker and fermented potato juice), Faux Fruit Sour (whiskey sour with koji fermentation).
mentions.verdict: Only bar in world with three Pinnacle guide pins.

mentions.videoTitle: Counter 71 is vastly underrated.
mentions.notes: Chef Joe Lake's first solo venture with a 16-course tasting menu for 16 seats around the kitchen. Topjaw praised the theatrical experience, world-class produce from the British Isles, and specific dishes including chicken Caesar taco and horseradish.
mentions.verdict: Vastly underrated, theatrical dining experience with excellent produce.

mentions.videoTitle: @MaxFosh - PINT SHOPPING at London’s Best Pubs
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and praised it as having beautiful wooden interiors, stained glass by the bar, great beers, and an excellent homemade ham and chips dish.
mentions.verdict: Beautiful pub, great beers, exceptional food menu.

mentions.videoTitle: Sandwiches worth queuing for. Cafe Mondo have created the sandwich shop we all dream of opening.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited this new sandwich shop and highlighted their exceptional fish finger sandwich made with fresh bread from next door and homemade sauce, pork and green sandwich, and other items like lacka and tartare.
mentions.verdict: Spectacular sandwich shop with incredible fish finger sandwich.

mentions.videoTitle: To keep improving for 11 years straight is not easy, well done The Camberwell Arms 👏
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed this gastro pub, highlighting its 11 years of continuous improvement under chef Mike's leadership. The pub sources whole carcass butchery in-house and maintains high-quality, simply-cooked dishes with strong identity.
mentions.verdict: One of London's best gastro pubs, consistently excellent.
dishes: Scotch bonnet & pork fat on toast
Lions mane mushrooms on toast with brown butter hollandaise
Tamworth pork sausage with wholegrain mustard
Cavolo nero, blood orange, black olives

mentions.videoTitle: Marco Pierre White hired Robin at 19 yrs old with no experience but a looooot of enthusiasm.
mentions.notes: Topjaw features this restaurant where they discuss the staff development approach, mentioning famous chefs like Gordon Ramsey, Tom Ainsley and Clivé Bürger visiting separately. The narrative centers on the chef's journey from being hired by Marco Pierre White at 19 with no experience but great enthusiasm, and the restaurant's philosophy of creating a perfect neighbourhood restaurant with bakery, bar and all-day service.
mentions.verdict: Great food, perfect neighbourhood restaurant concept.

mentions.videoTitle: Always LOVE going to Darbys, unfussy but exceptional flavours and industry leading service.
mentions.notes: Topjaw describes it as unfussy but with exceptional flavours and industry-leading service. They mention regularly enjoying visits and note the restaurant's reputation with top chefs.
mentions.verdict: Unfussy but exceptional flavours, industry-leading service.

mentions.videoTitle: Black Bear Burger, we love you.
mentions.notes: Topjaw highly praises Black Bear as one of the best burgers in London, calling it underrated. They highlight the signature Black Bear Burger with its 12-hour brined beef, rich velvety cheese, tangy onion jam, and specialty buns. They also mention standout sides including Brisket Spring Rolls and Rarebit Crumpet.
mentions.verdict: One of the best burgers in London, underrated.

mentions.videoTitle: The Martini final boss. The Connaught Bar, Mayfair, London.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and personally tried their signature martini. He praised it as refined, elegant and special, calling it the ultimate martini destination. The bartenders Ago and Giorgio are highlighted as having exceptional skills, with Giorgio winning International Bartender of the Year.
mentions.verdict: Refined, elegant martini cocktail bar. Top-tier establishment.

mentions.videoTitle: I think about this Massaman curry from Plaza Khao Gaeng a few times per week.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed their traditional South Thai cuisine. The Massaman curry is memorable enough to think about multiple times per week. The Deep South Menu at £35pp offers excellent value.
mentions.verdict: Unapologetically authentic Thai, flavors you don't get elsewhere.

mentions.videoTitle: Josephine Bouchon from Michelin starred Chef,Claude Bosi.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visits Claude Bosi's new bouchon-style restaurant inspired by his grandmother Josephine and Lyon tradition. Priced lower than Claude's other restaurants but maintains meticulous attention to detail with standout dishes including cheese soufflé, rabbit, and floating island.
mentions.verdict: Elevated, unfussy Lyon cooking with excellent execution.

mentions.videoTitle: IDRIS ELBA - PINT SHOPPING at London’s Best Pubs
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited Idris Elba's bar at Coal Drops Yard with a beautiful canal view. They had drinks (cognac) together and Idris discussed the location and atmosphere. Topjaw noted it's lovely in summertime when people sit outside on the grass or come in to eat.
mentions.verdict: Beautiful location with nice canal views and atmosphere.

mentions.videoTitle: One of London’s best French restaurants Bouchon Racine with iconic French chef Pierre Koffmann.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed multiple dishes at this French restaurant run by chef Henry Harris. They praised the herring, truffle cheese on toast, tripe, rabbit leg with Dijon mustard sauce, pig's head sausage, crème brûlée, and almond tart with crème fraîche.
mentions.verdict: Excellent French cuisine with beautifully prepared traditional dishes.
dishes: Rabbit leg with Dijon mustard sauce
Pig's head sausage with mashed potatoes and wine gravy

mentions.videoTitle: The 3 best dishes at Michelin starred Trinity, as chosen by the chef himself Adam Byatt
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited Trinity and spoke directly with chef Adam Byatt about his 3 best dishes on the menu. Byatt highlighted the salmon beurre blanc with dill, sweet bread with truffle, and honey sole with beeswax ice cream.
mentions.verdict: Michelin-starred restaurant with exceptional standout dishes.
dishes: Honey sole with beeswax ice cream

mentions.videoTitle: Any suggestions for the best Costa machine…? Full Episode now live 🍻
mentions.notes: Featured in the first episode of the new series Pint Shopping with comedian Rhys James. Described as one of London's best pubs.
mentions.verdict: One of London's best pubs

mentions.videoTitle: RHYS JAMES - PINT SHOPPING at London's Best Pubs.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited the pub with guest comedian Rhys James for the first episode of 'Pint Shopping' series. They ordered Guinness, tried bar snacks including sausages ('they're not going to serve you a rudimental ordinary bar snack'), and Rhys James confirmed he'd been there before and praised it as a 'fantastic pub'.
mentions.verdict: One of London's best pubs, fantastic Guinness and excellent bar snacks.

mentions.videoTitle: Are These East London's Best Take Away Spots? Bucket List Food.
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and approved: tamworth sausage hot dog, cod sandwich, hash browns and brown butter tarts. Commended the crisp exterior and soft middle of the hash browns.
mentions.verdict: Excellent crispy hash browns, seal of approval.

mentions.videoTitle: Akara is the lower price point sister restaurant to the Michelin starred Akoko.
mentions.notes: Topjaw reviewed multiple signature dishes including the aara, barbecue peri, pork skin with tank wood, Lagos chicken with sweet pepper sauce, and suya with rice. Called it one of the most underrated restaurants in London, praising it as casual, accessible and elevated West African dining.
mentions.verdict: One of London's most underrated restaurants, brilliant West African.
dishes: Lagos chicken with sweet pepper sauce

mentions.videoTitle: The 3 Best Spots in London’s Chinatown ft. Big John
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited with Big John and tasted multiple dumpling types including spicy vegetable and pork, prawn and pork dumplings. Big John tried truffle and caviar for the first time here.
mentions.verdict: Changed perception of Chinese food, excellent dumplings

mentions.videoTitle: The 3 Best Spots in London’s Chinatown ft. Big John
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited with Big John and ordered multiple roasted meats. Topjaw highlighted the roast duck with crispy skin and fattier roast duck, along with roast pork in sauce and fried noodles.
mentions.verdict: Best place for roast pork and roast duck, wonderful food

mentions.videoTitle: The 3 Best Spots in London’s Chinatown ft. Big John
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited with Big John to try Cantonese custard buns. Owner Zed created this place in 2017 to fill a gap in Chinatown for filled Cantonese buns.
mentions.verdict: Beautiful filled Cantonese custard buns, excellent quality

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Chef Michelle Trusselle recommended this as her go-to Deliveroo order. Topjaw visited and reviewed the bacon double cheeseburger, angry house fries, and Black & White shake, praising the quality of the meat, bun sourcing, and overall execution.
mentions.verdict: Outstanding burger with meticulous sourcing and execution.

mentions.videoTitle: BEST BURGER IN LONDON - REVISITED: BLEECKER ST
mentions.notes: Topjaw tried the Bleecker Black double patty with black pudding in the middle. Praised it as exceptionally soft, tasting more like cake than meat. Named world's best burger by Foodie Hub and won London Burger Bash.
mentions.verdict: Soft, rich black pudding burger beats previous best burger choice.
dishes: Bleecker Black double patty with black pudding

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Chef Mandy Yin recommended this as her frequent Deliveroo order. Topjaw visited the restaurant on Upper Street and reviewed the wonton in signature sauce, fried king oyster mushrooms, and crispy tofu, noting the meaty textures and flavours despite being plant-based.
mentions.verdict: Excellent vegan dishes with satisfying meaty textures and complex sauces.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Chef Joe Laker recommended this Turkish kebab spot. Topjaw visited and reviewed the special mix for two, praising the quality of the meats (chicken shish, lamb shish, chicken wings, kofta, doner), noting the handmade layers.
mentions.verdict: Authentic Turkish kebabs with excellent quality meats and 14-year heritage.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Chef Sally Abe recommended this as her go-to Deliveroo order for Sichuan food. Topjaw visited and reviewed the traditional boiled fish in chilli oil, Gongbao king prawns, and stir fried water spinach, praising the numbing spice and theatrical presentation.
mentions.verdict: Outstanding Sichuan cuisine with thrilling spice and incredible flavour.
dishes: Traditional boiled fish in chilli oil
Stir fried water spinach with garlic sauce

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Chef Robin Gill from Darby's recommended this pizzeria. Topjaw visited and reviewed the Diavola Picante and Norma pizzas, praising the crispy crust style and high-quality ingredients, noting the strict quality control from the Italian bosses.
mentions.verdict: Exceptional pizza with crispy crust and premium Italian ingredients.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Best Food Delivery: Where Chefs Eat
mentions.notes: Topjaw's own favourite restaurant. Topjaw visited and reviewed multiple dishes including bhel puri, beef keema, old Delhi chicken, samosa chaat, and Keralan fried chicken, praising the complexity, richness, and masterful execution of the Indian cuisine.
mentions.verdict: Masterful Indian cuisine with rich complexity and theatrical presentation.

mentions.videoTitle: We find the 3 Best Indian Restaurants in London
mentions.notes: Topjaw visited and reviewed this affordable Indian fusion restaurant with small plates. He praised it as 'absolutely love that place' and 'contemporary Indian,' reviewing multiple dishes and cocktails at length. Founded by friends Will (chef) and Rick (front of house).
mentions.verdict: Contemporary Indian small plates, incredible flavor in every bite.
dishes: Lamb ribs with wild garlic naan
Hiriali tikka trowel with tomato chutney

mentions.videoTitle: Brat on brat action @officialcharlixcx with her Best of #London
mentions.notes: Charli XCX states 'I really love brat' as one of her best restaurant recommendations in London.
